newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cheuvreux adds Axa to favoured list.
newsitem.headline: Cheuvreux adds Axa to favoured list.

text.p: Brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu added Axa SA to its list of recommended shares, replacing Club Mediterranee shares which were removed from the list on Wednesday, portfolio managers said on Friday.

They said Cheuvreux cited Axa's strong profit-growth prospects, its big international presence, clean balance sheet and the stock's underperformance since the start of the year. Axa shares were up 1.28 percent at 317.20 francs.
Cheuvreux dropped Club Med after the resort group forecast flat second-half pre-tax, pre-exceptional profit. Its shares were up three francs at 330, recouping a fraction of their recent losses.
